notes.title: SKIPCHASER 1.5 is live!
notes.notes:
In celebration of our new game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302440/RogueJack_Roguelike_Blackjack/]RogueJack[/url] releasing on Steam a couple of days ago, we've packaged up some QoE updates for SKIPCHASER and added a few new features.

Here's the breakdown of whats new:
[list]
    [*]Sliding difficulty scale that buff enemies the less you die 
    [*]In-level vending machines that let you try out some of the weapon parts for a limited time
    [*]64-bit and signing issues on macOS
    [*]Keep bosses from blowing themselves up
    [*]Missile bullets?!?!?!
    [*]Various Steelseries keyboard fixes
[/list]

We've also added [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302440/RogueJack_Roguelike_Blackjack/]RogueJack[/url] to our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15142/Ponywolf_Franchise/]Ponywolf Franchise bundle[/url], so if you supported us in the past you can get our new game for an even deeper discount.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27821198/813c96aacc22959c5741c89bf09388cd43f4d050.png[/img]

Thanks for playing and supporting Ponywolf

notes.title: 1.1.3 is out with SteelSeries Engine Support
notes.notes:
Version 1.1.3 updates some SDK stuff under the hood and adds color shifting support for SteelSeries Keyboards, Mice and Headsets. We don't overwrite your settings, just supplement them with a FnKey health bar and  key cap highlights for key bindings.

If you are a developer and want to add these features to your game, we've posted the Lua code on [url=https://github.com/ponywolf/ponysense]Github[/url].

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - SKIPCHASER
notes.notes:
SKIPCHASER is Now Available on Steam!

SKIPCHASER is a story-driven sci-fi fantasy shooter with procedural missions, deep weapon customization and action/adventure elements.

notes.title: SKIPCHASER Leaving Early Access 6/4
notes.notes:
That's right, SKIPCHASER is leaving Early Access June 4th, after about 16 months and 40+ public builds. The second Release Candidate is currently in public beta and we will spend the upcoming weekend playing and bug fixing for a Monday launch.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27821198/b94221f62cb11b4c57617de6df2e374baf1ea9c7.gif[/img]

The price will remain at $4.99 USD (or local equivalent) and has 10 missions spanning 60+ levels. Our best guess at gameplay is probably 7 to 8 hours before the missions start recycling.

notes.title: Final Boss Battle Update Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
As we progress on various updates this summer, we'd really like to put a bow on Skipchaser in it's current form. So, to that end we're going to implement all the levels we have by fleshing out the town, dropping in the final boss battle and wrapping up the storyline.

So, this should come as good news to everyone who wanted to see Skipchaser completed as a stand-alone twin stick shooter/rogue-lke. We can't put an exact day on it, but things are pretty much content complete outside of a few effects and dialog passes.

notes.title: Overhauling SKIPCHASER in 2018
notes.notes:
Let’s be clear, SKIPCHASER isn’t what anyone would consider a success story. It started as a [url=http://ponywolf.com/the-mimic/]Ludum Dare game jam entry[/url] in April of 2016, went into Steam Early Access March of 2017, and one year later hasn’t really hit its stride as anything more than a colorful but simplistic rogue-like twin-stick shooter.

Despite being featured on Itch.io (thanks BTW) and getting some minor press and streaming play, purchases have been in the low hundreds and our team’s vision to build “Space Diablo” isn’t in the cards--mainly the financial cards.

Don’t get me wrong, our team at Ponywolf clearly isn’t profit focused--a vast majority of our games are free with no ads. We also have released thousands of lines of code to help the gaming community on the whole. Simply put, we build games that we want to play, but at some point a game needs to be sustainable.

Up to now, this statement reads like a studio that’s planning on canceling their flagship title--but this is not the case. During the concepting phase of SKIPCHASER we experimented with many different kinds of game play options, from side scrolling, to click mashing, to what you see today. One of those experiments was a turn-based, drag-to-move control scheme that worked well in both mouse based and touch screen environments.

We lifted some of that code and implemented it in the re-release of [url=https://ponywolf.itch.io/1-800-monsters]1-800-Monsters[/url] mainly the ability to drag the mouse to control where the hero character walks.

[url=https://imgur.com/2AcpiC5][img]http://i.imgur.com/2AcpiC5.gif[/img][/url]

That said, I’m happy to announce our intent to overhaul SKIPCHASER into a more unique turn based action game and deliver more content updates in 2018. Those of you who supported us in Early Access, this branch of the game will remain available indefinitely, and you will hopefully get another great experience set in the SKIPCHASER universe.

Michael Wilson,
Founder, Ponywolf

notes.title: SKIPCHASER in 2018
notes.notes:
[I]Editing this post to clear up any confusion.[/I]

We are now in the final throws of a Release Candidate to implement the rest of the levels/bosses and are tightening up the story line to make SKIPCHASER a complete experience after a little over a year in Early Access.

We still want to play with these characters in a turned-based world, but we will leave that for another day--and another post.

Thank you for your support! 

Michael Wilson,
Founder, Ponywolf

notes.title: SKIPCHASER Early Access Update 4 Live
notes.notes:
Not much to say. Oh wait, we added a whole new mechanic called "skipping." It's a bullet-time effect that allows you to teleport into a local space nearby the player. You can hold the "skip" as long as you want to plan your next course of action. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/STcTtLT.gif[/img]

Also, as usual we've added more content...
[list]
    [*]Updated particle systems
    [*]Skip transition effect
    [*]Auto-frameskipping for slower systems
    [*]DOOM-like face damage in HUD
    [*]Weapon re-balancing
    [*]Ability to stun enemies
    [*]...and much, much more
[/list]

Have fun, and as always feedback in the forums helps us make the game better.

notes.title: Preview SKIPCHASER Early Access Update 4
notes.notes:
We are putting the finishing touches on SKIPCHASER's Update #4. We've done quite a bit of rebalancing, bug fixes and added a new gameplay twist. "Skipping" is an ability to slow time to a crawl and hop to a new position close on the map. It's an *beta* feature for sure, so feedback is welcome.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/eGBy1nT.gif[/img]

This feature replaces the little used "jump" and uses what was the "shield" energy that wasn't explained very well. I hope this gets the difficulty balancing back on track so we can focus on fresh content in Update 5.

Speaking of Update 5, there are a raft of things that didn't get ready for Update 4 that are still in the works for a future update
[list]
    [*]Act 1 finale
    [*]GameJolt launch
    [*]Updated SFX/Ambient sound 
    [*]New save format
    [*]PS4 Controller support
    [*]3 new music tracks and OST DLC
[/list]

Plus we still added a few killer features...
[list]
    [*]Better joystick as mouse functions 
    [*]Updated gun colors
    [*]SFX updates (still more to come)
    [*]Weapon text updated,  avoids mouse
    [*]Map "dead exit" fix
    [*]Dialog updates
    [*]HD UI elements (mouse pointer, buttons, etc.)
[/list]

Enjoy this update!

notes.title: SKIPCHASER Early Access Update 2

So much to talk about. Update 2 is here and it’s got a bunch of new content and updates to existing functionality. Let’s just get to it...

[img]http://i.imgur.com/026aOnb.gif[/img]
[list]

[*]Story dialog re-worked (restart needed)
[*]Shooting robot enemy class
[*]Skeleton warlock enemy class
[*]Human grenadier class
[*]Landmine classes (bio, pyro, cryo)
[*]Trading cards!!!
[*]Variable grenade distance (called out in almost every “let’s play”)
[*]Enemy AI improvements (turrets, humans, bots)
[*]Pause, exit menu, terminal now combined into "super" terminal
[*]Bug fixes (various)
[*]And much, much more…
[/list]
As always, report bugs/issues as you find them and we’ll have another content update in 2 weeks. Thanks again for everyone supporting us in Early Access on Steam!

notes.title: Launch week nearly over, UPDATE 2 is coming
notes.notes:
What a week. SKIPCHASER went live (albeit in early access), we presented and demoed at Hackfort (a digital conference in Boise, ID) and still managed to squeeze in some time to address feedback from plays, streams and reviews. 

UPDATE 2 is still a week away, but there are a few things I can confirm that will make the next build.

[list]
    [*]Variable grenade distance (called out in almost every stream)
    [*]Fixed bullets through walls (rare)
    [*]Removed "hiccup" on dialog showing
    [*]Enemy AI improvments (turrets, badguys, bots)
    [*]Pause, exit menu, terminal now combined into "super" terminal
    [*]Mission arrow outlined for visibility
    [*]Trading cards!!!
    [*]...and more stuff we can't confirm
[/list]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/H3YIZqa.gif[/img]

But for now, if you haven't picked it up, today is the last day of our 10% launch discount. So, hop on board if you are interested...

notes.title: Early Access Plan
notes.notes:
I wanted to share our plan for SKIPCHASER while it's in early access. Those of you with closed beta keys and those who buy into the EA launch are seeing about 25% of the first of three acts. Our plan as of right now, is to continue to push content updates, progressing the storyline and finishing the planned features until our "official" release in early July.

Releases will be every other week for 12 release cycles, and we will look to the community to help us prioritize features, tweak the missions and story line and balance the gameplay. We will share our proposed roadmap following a build and allow players to weigh in.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27821198/bb534bd059a39e20f49c2bb24df9206f46abb6bc.png[/img]

Our hope is to release a well crafted twin-stick shooter with a story and engage the audience that wants to play something like that throughout the process.

If you are interested, follow SKIPCHASER on Steam for more frequent updates.

    [*]More random map types (rogue-like and fenced)
    [*]Spacebase merged into space hub
    [*]Cave entrance updates
    [*]Weapon part unlock fix
    [*]Updated tilesets for random maps
    [*]UI tweaks for mouse and gamepad
    [*]More audio design
[/list]
See you at GDC!
